intro: Today's briefing highlights a major court ruling regarding AI blacklisting and new updates from Google and Meta. These developments reflect the ongoing tension between rapid AI innovation and regulatory scrutiny.

must_know.title: Anthropic was illegally blacklisted by the Trump administration, court rules
must_know.summary: A judge has ruled that the Trump administration's blacklisting of Anthropic was unconstitutional, resolving a lawsuit regarding alleged retaliation over AI red-teaming.
must_know.why_it_matters: This ruling establishes a significant precedent for AI companies challenging government restrictions on their operations.

must_know.title: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash lets you build with more control
must_know.summary: Google has released Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, providing developers with improved control and new tools for building applications.
must_know.why_it_matters: Enhanced developer control often leads to more stable and specialized applications built on Google's foundation models.

must_know.title: Meta addresses ‘pervert glasses’ reputation with a privacy fix and a new marketing campaign
must_know.summary: Meta is updating its smart glasses to prevent recording when the front-facing LED indicator light is physically covered.
must_know.why_it_matters: This update directly addresses long-standing privacy concerns regarding the covert surveillance potential of wearable AI hardware.

policy.title: Buried in Meta’s $18B settlement is a legal pass on kids’ data
policy.summary: Meta's recent $18 billion settlement includes provisions allowing the company to retain data from children under 13 to improve age-detection models.
policy.why_it_matters: The deal highlights a complex trade-off between privacy regulations and the data requirements needed to build safety systems for minors.

foundation-models.title: Google announces Gemini 3.5 Transcribe for AI-powered speech-to-text
foundation-models.summary: Google introduced Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, an AI-powered speech-to-text model, for integration into Chrome and other Google products.
foundation-models.why_it_matters: This represents a wider expansion of Google's proprietary AI transcription tech beyond mobile into web browsing environments.

tools.title: Google’s AI note-taking app now allows you to interact with books
tools.summary: Google's Gemini Notebook app now allows users to ingest books purchased from Google Play to generate summaries, podcasts, and infographics.
tools.why_it_matters: Google is integrating its AI tools more deeply into its ecosystem of purchased digital content.
